warrants.quote: “APAC Public Warrants” are to the 7,666,667 APAC Warrants, a fraction equal to one-third of which was included in each unit sold as part of APAC’s initial public offering
“APAC Private Placement Warrants” are to the 8,233,333 APAC Warrants that were issued to the Sponsor in a private placement in connection with APAC’s initial public offering
